info.title: Paysafe Applications API
info.description:
White-labelled merchant onboarding. Submit applications, track underwriting decisions and manage sub-merchant accounts programmatically, individually or in bulk.

---

**DEMO SPECIFICATION — NOT A REAL PAYSAFE API.** This document was generated for a GitBook proof of concept. The endpoints, schemas and examples are fabricated and describe no live Paysafe system. For the real Paysafe API, see https://developer.paysafe.com.

tags.name: Sub-merchants
tags.description: Manage sub-merchant accounts created from approved applications.

tags.name: Termination inquiry
tags.description: Screen sub-merchants against scheme termination databases.

post.description: Creates a new application. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of applications, most recent first.
Retrieves a single application by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing application.

post.description: Submits a completed application for underwriting review.
Withdraws an application that has not yet been decisioned.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of businesses, most recent first.
Retrieves a single business by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing business.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of owners, most recent first.
Retrieves a single owner by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing owner.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of documents, most recent first.
Retrieves a single document by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing document.

post.description: Triggers automated verification of an uploaded document.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sub-merchants, most recent first.
Retrieves a single sub-merchant by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing sub-merchant.

post.description: Terminates a sub-merchant account and stops further processing.

get.description: Retrieves a single termination inquiry by its Paysafe id.

merchantRefNum.description: Your own unique reference. Reuse it on a retry to avoid a double charge.

Amount.description: Amount in the currency's **minor unit**. 4999 is $49.99. See Currency codes for each currency's exponent.

state.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for US and CA addresses.

isControlProng.description: True for the individual with significant management responsibility.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, not on `message`.

message.example: Either you submitted a request that is missing a mandatory field or the value of a field does not match the format expected.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — a field is missing or malformed.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return.

MerchantRefNum.name: merchantRefNum
MerchantRefNum.description: Filter by your own reference number.
